text.card: A red giant 3,116 parsecs away, 16 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 12, give 0.82 solar masses and 16.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,572 K at its surface.
